name: Mock Data
description: Generate realistic test data in Chinese or English as JSON, CSV or SQL
help: Define the columns you need and pick a type for each; values within a row stay consistent: emails follow names, and birthdays, ages and ID numbers agree with each other.
Chinese data uses real provinces and cities, valid mobile prefixes and 18-digit ID numbers with correct check digits (for testing only).
The same seed always produces the same data. The preview shows the first 200 rows; saving writes every row with the same seed.
Generate up to 100,000 rows as JSON, JSON Lines, CSV or SQL INSERT statements for MySQL, PostgreSQL or SQLite.
